environment: Linux sandbox; no new Windows or GPU inference validation
method: Actual fresh public feeds and decoded image downloads. Default free-store adapters; no local imports, API key, paid provider, CAPTCHA solver or generated products.
earlier_probe_issues: Early aiohttp probes returned 429; final implementation uses standard requests/urllib3 with public-IP-pinned sockets. This is the primary transport, not an in-search bypass/fallback.
Original femella.in redirected to www.femmella.com; canonical approved source updated.
250-record page on Nobero exceeded response bound; changed to at most three 100-record pages.
Maxi skirt category initially inferred as dress; fixed explicit-category priority and added regression test.
